note: Controlled parent mapping for the Chinese province/city geography layer. The frozen archive states every level inside the entry text ('City (市), Province (省), China (中国)'); this file records that reading explicitly so the generator never infers a parent from code shape alone.
rule: An archive code '<A>-CN' is a province whose parent is the country node CN.
An archive code '<A>-<B>-CN' is a city whose parent is province '<B>-CN'.
The province label is the second parenthesised segment of the child entry; it must be present before the mapping is accepted.
A code whose entry does not name every level, or whose parent code is absent from this mapping and from the archive, is rejected by the generator instead of being guessed.

GXZ-CN.reason: Five Guizhou-coded city entries in the archive (NN-GXZ-CN, LZ-GXZ-CN, GL-GXZ-CN, WZ-GXZ-CN, BH-GXZ-CN) use the province segment GXZ, which has no province-level entry of its own. CN-GXZ-CN is therefore kept as a distinct node so those codes still resolve; it is not merged into GX-CN because the archive never states that they are the same administrative unit.
